items.title: Derrick Gardner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 9, 2013
items.q: Prince — the R&B and soul artist — he was probably one of the first ones to really manipulate the internet early in its infancy.

ctx.x: Yeah, that’s right, that’s right, that’s right. You know I also mentioned earlier in this interview about the fact that there are ways around — not having to use a record company in order to get your music out there. That ties in with that you know. The © Hamilton College Jazz Archive -10-

internet has become an incredible resource for musicians and we have to learn how to manipulate the internet in order to make our small business a successful one. Because as a musician you essentially are starting your own small business and you are the product. So you have to use the internet in a way of marketing/publicity, and you have to use the internet as far as getting your music out there in the way of distribution.
